_about: Traceability of the recovery contract (PLAN bind-merge-held-plan.md; T29 in recovery.red.mjs). Every release control is listed. A control is `covered` only by named Cases that exist in 00-changes/cases.md, or `pending` with the step whose RED must add them: a pending control is a mandatory later RED, not an exception. `liveProof` is `pending` until a run shows the recovery action re-triggers the check on GitHub; the YAML trigger Cases (T26) are static evidence only. Covering a control means its own fail and held verdicts, not another control's.

bind Merge.scope: the auto-merge verdicts only; its remaining verdicts come with the Branching split

evidence.trial: throwaway pull request #1360 into kaal/engineering-release-management, closed unmerged; Owner go 10 November 2026 (scoped: existing protections, no admin override, no change to required checks, rulesets or gates)
evidence.head: 01eaf1ddce6e43ec5e44ce10ff36cb4fd79b2f28

failing.reason: Auto-merge is disabled for this pull request into kaal/engineering-release-management (KAAL_AUTO_MERGE empty)

recovery.action: enable auto-merge with squash (the same enablePullRequestAutoMerge mutation `gh pr merge <branch> --auto --squash` calls; performed through the GitHub MCP tool because the session's gh CLI is not authenticated)

evidence.unchanged: required checks, rulesets and gates were not touched; the pull request was closed unmerged and auto-merge disabled
evidence.limits: proves the enable action starts a fresh Branching run on the same head and that it passes; the verdict text with Recovery lines runs from the base once #1358 lands. The disable-then-enable path (wrong method) is not covered by this trial.

bind Merge.dependency: The recovery event is `auto_merge_enabled`/`auto_merge_disabled` on the workflow that issues the verdict, today lineage-synchronization.yml on `pull_request_target`. The Owner has disabled `pull_request_target` as a policy and GitHub blocks it on 2 December 2026, so the Branching split (the Change that moves Branching to a design that does not need it) must carry the same events (the `pull_request` event has the same activity types) and T26 must read them from the new trigger block, then the live proof is repeated there; until then this proof holds for the current workflow only.
